notes.title: The “Singing Stones VR” Update features
notes.notes:
For our planned update of 2016 we've made some fixes and improvements for you to enjoy the game.
[*] In this version of the project you can explore the island and collect diamonds without VR-headset, just using your keyboard and mouse.
[*] We`ve fixed the sound 
[*] When the game is finished you can exit it by pressing “Esc” button 
[*] Also we`ve fixed wrong colliders 
We look forward to create more exciting locations in 2017!
